title: Project: Validated Microservice
summary: Build a framework-free API core: a declarative validation layer that reports every error, a typed error hierarchy with HTTP status mapping, and a dispatcher with per-request dependency injection.

rubric.label: Correctness
rubric.description: Every visible and hidden test passes: coercion, constraints, complete error reporting, status mapping, dispatch and injection.

rubric.label: Error reporting
rubric.description: Validation collects every problem with the path to the offending value instead of stopping at the first, and each failure maps to the right HTTP status.

rubric.label: Request lifetimes
rubric.description: A dependency is constructed once per request, is never shared between requests, and is torn down even when the handler raises.
